title: D CORE Fiber Optic BiDi 40G/100G 1310nm Dual Fiber LC/UPC to Single DWM MUX

items.h: Connector Type:  Input: LC/UPC (Dual Fiber), Output: Single Fiber DWDM

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE Fiber Optical BiDi 40G/100G DWDM MUX is a high-performance optical wavelength multiplexer designed to aggregate 40G or 100G optical signals from dual fiber LC/UPC interfaces into a single DWDM fiber line. Operating at 1310nm, this device enables efficient fiber utilization, long-distance transmission, and reduced infrastructure cost.


This DWDM MUX is ideal for data centers, telecom networks, ISP backbone links, and metro fiber networks, supporting high-bandwidth applications with low insertion loss and excellent wavelength stability. Built with premium optical components, it ensures reliable, interference-free performance in mission-critical environments.


Key Features

  • Supports 40G & 100G BiDi optical transmission
  • Converts Dual Fiber LC/UPC to Single Fiber DWDM
  • Operates at 1310nm wavelength
  • High channel isolation & low insertion loss
  • Passive design – no power required
  • Compact, rack-mount or module-based installation
  • Ideal for DWDM backbone & metro networks
